    To StartDa-da-da-dum cheese and herb scrollsBeethoven barks along to the Fifth. Soft scrolls, tasty cheese, chives.How to make it375g self-raising flour60g cold butter, cubed250ml milk3 tbsp tomato paste200g tasty cheese, grated2 tbsp chives, chopped1 tsp dried oreganoRub the butter into the flour with a pinch of salt, then stir in the milk to a soft dough.Roll out to a 30 x 40cm rectangle, spread with tomato paste and scatter with cheese, chives and oregano.Roll up from the long side, cut into 12 rounds and pack into a lined tin.Bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.Sparky's mini corn dogs with tomato sauceSparky bites Dr Varnick. Little franks in sweet corn batter.How to make it16 mini frankfurts100g fine cornmeal (polenta)100g plain flour1 tbsp caster sugar2 tsp baking powder1 egg200ml milk1 L vegetable oil, for frying125ml tomato sauce16 short wooden skewersWhisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the egg and milk to a thick batter.Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each.Pour the batter into a tall glass, dip each frank and fry at 180°C until deep golden.Drain and serve with tomato sauce.A bowl of pretzels on the benchOut of Beethoven's reach. Mostly.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsGeorge's backyard barbecue cheeseburgersBeethoven wrecks George's barbecue. Beef patties, cheese, pickles, burger sauce.How to make it600g beef mince4 soft burger buns4 slices of cheddar2 tomatoes, sliced4 lettuce leaves8 dill pickle slices4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp yellow mustardSeason the mince well and shape into 4 patties a little wider than the buns.Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and mustard into burger sauce.Grill or barbecue the patties 3 to 4 minutes a side, laying the cheese on for the last minute.Toast the buns and build with sauce, lettuce, tomato, patty and pickles.Brad and Brie's three-cheese mac with crunchy crumbsThe ride Brad and Brie deserved. Cheddar, mozzarella and brie, golden crumbs.How to make it400g macaroni50g butter3 tbsp plain flour750ml milk150g tasty cheese, grated100g mozzarella, grated125g brie, rind trimmed and chopped60g panko breadcrumbs1 tsp sweet paprikaCook the macaroni 2 minutes short of the packet time and drain.Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.Stir in the cheeses until melted, then fold through the pasta and tip into a baking dish.Scatter with the panko and paprika and bake at 200°C until golden and bubbling.Something SweetLate-night giant choc chip skillet cookieBeethoven's late-night cookie and TV. Warm, gooey, big enough for a St Bernard.How to make it125g butter, melted150g brown sugar50g caster sugar1 egg1 tsp vanilla extract200g plain flour1/2 tsp bicarb soda200g milk chocolate chips1 L vanilla ice creamWhisk the melted butter with both sugars, then beat in the egg and vanilla.Stir in the flour, bicarb and a pinch of salt, then the chocolate chips.Press into a buttered 25cm ovenproof frying pan and bake at 180°C until golden at the edges and soft in the middle.Cool for 5 minutes and serve straight from the pan with scoops of ice cream.To DrinkBackyard pool blue lemonadeBeethoven saves Emily at the pool. Butterfly pea tea that turns purple with lemon.How to make it4 butterfly pea flower tea bags500ml boiling water100g caster sugar4 lemons, juiced500ml soda water, chilled2 cups ice cubesSteep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then stir in the sugar and chill.Fill 4 glasses with ice and pour in the blue tea and the soda.Pour the lemon juice in at the table and watch it turn purple.A jug of cold milkFor the cookies.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
